command:
set +e
W=$(pwd)
grep -rn "FT_Cos\|FT_Atan2\|FT_Angle_Diff\|yD4-QaNSink\|p90G4PB-rPc\|D1l8+Bu+-Y8\|P6WOAeb0lJ8" core/libs/prx/libSceFreeTypeOt | head
curl -sL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DNNDHH/PS5-3.20_Libs/b2a77c09cd71c01f34c790cfbe98c751a13262ad/libSceFreeTypeOt.c -o /tmp/inv.c
for k in P6WOAeb0lJ8 yD4-QaNSink p90G4PB-rPc D1l8+Bu+-Y8 3WpTQrvGUcU 1jmC2QcpRl0 HMcNe70D9TI 2rmvbvOCyjY dojyaLKzKN0; do grep -n -m1 -- "$k" /tmp/inv.c; done
grep -n "jmp" /tmp/inv.c | wc -l
cd /tmp
for v in 2.4.11 2.4.12; do curl -sL -o ft-$v.tgz https://download.savannah.gnu.org/releases/freetype/freetype-old/freetype-$v.tar.gz && tar xzf ft-$v.tgz; done
echo "== 2.4.12 ftcalc FT_BASE decls"; grep -n -B1 "^  FT_MSB\|^  FT_Hypot\|^  ft_highpow2\|^  FT_Sqrt32\|^  ft_corner_is_flat\|^  ft_corner_orientation" freetype-2.4.12/src/base/ftcalc.c
grep -rn "ft_highpow2" freetype-2.4.11/src/base/*.c | head -3
echo "== ftconfig STDC"; grep -n -A6 "FT_CONFIG_OPTION_FORCE_INT64 )" freetype-2.4.11/include/freetype/config/ftconfig.h | head -20
echo "== 2.4.11 fttrigon.c"; sed -n '/^#include <ft2build.h>/,$p' freetype-2.4.11/src/base/fttrigon.c
echo "== 2.4.11 fttrigon.h defines"; grep -n "#define FT_ANGLE" freetype-2.4.11/include/freetype/fttrigon.h
